model.name: Task 30.26: Deep-link right-pick preserves the user's pick (BUG-1)
model.description: Deep-link right-pick preservation: open a diff from a deep-link URL, then pick a RIGHT ref — the user's pick is preserved (RIGHT = the picked ref), NOT clobbered by the in-flight deep-link/right load. openFromParams guards against a user pick landing mid-load (R30.25.1); loadSide uses a _rightLoadSeq sequence token so a stale in-flight load returning after a newer pick is discarded — newest load wins (R30.25.2).
